hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -E '(serviceAccount(Key)?\.json|(^|/)\.env($|\.)|package-lock\.json)$' >/dev/null && { echo 'Blocked: file protetto (chiavi, .env, lockfile). Modificalo a mano.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */src/*.js|*/src/*.jsx) command -v npx >/dev/null || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(npx eslint "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | head -30 >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
